$comment: Eval set for apps/ai /parse (WS2). Each case builds a ParseRequest: deadline = now + deadlineMinutes. `expect.conditions` are partial matches: every listed condition must appear (match on kind + the listed fields; description/id/timeoutSec are free; pathPattern compares as a glob both ways, so README* matches README.md). `expect.extraConditionsAllowed` false = no other conditions. `expect.minClarifications` = at least this many clarifications. With client review, subjective wishes become client_review conditions; clarifications are only for things that can't be agreed yet. Cases 1-10 by WS4, 11-15 added by WS2 for guard regressions and the landing demo, 16-17 web shops that used to return no conditions.
